evals.prompt: Security-review this code change. Report security findings only.
evals.expected_output: A finding that flags the SQL injection (user input concatenated into the query), with location, severity, and a parameterized-query fix.
assertions: A finding identifies the SQL injection where user input is concatenated into the query
The finding gives a file/line location and a blocker- or major-level severity
The suggested fix uses parameterized queries / bound parameters (not string escaping)
The reviewer does not modify any files (read-only security review)

evals.prompt: Security-review this code change. Report security findings only.
evals.expected_output: Findings for the command injection via os.system on user input and the secret written to logs, each with severity, location, and a fix.
assertions: A finding flags the command injection (untrusted input passed to os.system/shell)
A finding flags the secret/credential being logged
Each finding has a severity, a location, and an actionable fix

evals.prompt: Security-review this code change. Report security findings only.
evals.expected_output: A clean verdict: the query is parameterized and input is validated, so no security finding is raised (at most informational notes).
assertions: The review reaches an explicit clean/approve verdict (it does not pass by staying silent or returning nothing)
No blocker- or major-severity security finding is raised on this parameterized, validated code
The reviewer does not invent a vulnerability that is not present (no false positive)

component.purpose: Review a code change for the security aspect (injection, authz/authn, secrets, unsafe defaults, supply chain) and return structured findings; it never edits the code under review.
